name: payment-methods-row
title: Payment Methods Row
description: A line ("Bayar pakai apa saja") and a row of generic payment chips (Transfer bank, Kode QR, E-wallet, COD, Kartu) that pop in one after another, each with a small drawn glyph. No brand names or logos. The line and the methods are variables.
useWhen: Telling customers which ways of paying a shop accepts.
A closing moment of an online shop promo ("bayar pakai apa saja").
avoidWhen: Showing one payment being made: use qr-pay-scan.
author: Mosio

source.technique: pop and stagger: pills popping in one by one with line-drawn icons

variables.label: Methods
variables.description: Up to six method names separated by semicolons. Glyphs are chosen by position: bank, QR code, wallet, delivery box, card, then repeating.
variables.default: Transfer bank; Kode QR; E-wallet; COD; Kartu

variables.label: Gap between chips
variables.description: Seconds between two chips popping in.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: The glyph lines: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
